title: Seahawks’ top challenger on road to Super Bowl defense should be the Rams. But with more than 100 days until that test, Patriots arrive first

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks’ top challenger on road to Super Bowl defense should be the Rams. But with more than 100 days until that test, Patriots arrive first
sources.description: So while the Patriots stand first on the Seahawks’ schedule for a Super Bowl rematch, the team far more pertinent to Seattle’s road back to the biggest stage has been loading up loudly and repeatedly.
